description: JoyCaption's SigLIP attention-pooling head is a `torch.nn.MultiheadAttention`, whose parameter is ONE fused q|k|v `in_proj_weight` (and `in_proj_bias`). Contiguous thirds, so T2: manifest range-slicing over the same chunks.
name: joycaption.siglip-head-split-to-fused
provenance: One of the two fused axes tensorfs#150 FOUND rather than inherited — it was invisible to every generated candidate because a header cannot show a fusion. Silent-error class: a reader that split this head's q|k|v any other way gets every name, dtype and shape right and every number wrong.

seams.provenance: RATIFIED 2026-08-20 (tensorfs#150), transplanted from `joycaption.llava-bf16@1`. Proved twice: from the module definition — the pooling head is `torch.nn.MultiheadAttention`, which stores q, k and v as one `in_proj_weight` — and from the measured shape, [3456, 1152] = 3 x 1152 with the SigLIP hidden size 1152. Equal thirds, contiguous, in q, k, v order: that is MultiheadAttention's own layout and not a choice made here.

RATIFIED with the weight seam above (tensorfs#150): the bias travels with the weight and splits the same way, [3456] = 3 x 1152, in q, k, v order. Same citation — torch.nn.MultiheadAttention's own in_proj layout.
